text_block_list.text:
It had been a while since I became Durandal's
trainer.
The days we spent working together were
going swimmingly——

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
Inspection and warming-up of my joints has
been completed.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My 『Holy Sword』 is in pristine order.
Now, please give me my orders.
choice_data_list: Let's start with a light warm-up

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Understood,
my lord. A canter worthy of the King,
I swear to demonstrate it without fail.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes. My King's will be done——

text_block_list.name: Formative Trainer
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're getting along just fine.

The person that called out to me was the
person who inspired
me to become a trainer,
the senpai trainer that I looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Formative Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
it's the training of a duo that's getting
a lot of
attention now. ……But still,
is Durandal the same as ever?
『Durandal, I beseech thee』

『——Victory, glory,
jubilation. These are the duties of an
Uma Musume. Swear, as a protector,
to uphold these values』

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes——I swear. From this day forth,
as your knight,
I will strive to fulfill that role.

Ever since that knighting ceremony,
she has been serving faithfully as my
knight.

Everyday I would need to aim to reach
higher and higher towards her ideals.

text_block_list.name: Formative Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaa, that's a good look on you.
It looks like you really are getting along—
—but listen well.

text_block_list.name: Formative Trainer
text_block_list.text:
In the future,
if someone who looks down on her dream
were to appear,
you alone cannot turn away from her.

text_block_list.name: Formative Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Trainers are the supporting pillars to an
Uma Musume's dream.
Never forget that you are their "Steadfast
Guide".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(What's going on?……Trainer-dono's gaze feels
much more intense
than usual today.
Have my knightly qualities improved?)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu……in that case,
I must prove it. That my power is
even more brilliant——
With a flourish of the 『Holy Sword』!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ——Haaaaaaaaaaa!

I couldn't help but be mesmerized by her
sudden acceleration.
Her overwhelming closing power would
allow her to chase even in short distance
races——

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
——My lord.
Durandal has returned.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ……Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You said start with 『light warm-up』,
but... I felt weight of your expectations,
so unconsciously moved to live up to
them...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However,
I wish to be your knight and protector.
Fulfilling this is my purpose.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To that end,
to sharpen my sword—
my desire is to give my all in each race—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My running, all of it,
for my esteemed King. With this 『Holy Sword』,
I will without fail bring unending glory to
my King.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: I believe you will achieve results
I believe you will achieve results

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (……Aaaah, truly has to be this person——)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(They deeply believe in me,
affirming my pride as knight to this extent.
And also——)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(They praise me loooooots! Always genuinely,
more than anyone!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ——Trainer-dono. My noble "King".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My 『Holy Sword』 will always be at your side.
As long as... you desire it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
on to next menu! All for my revered King——

Durandal headed to sloped course with great
enthusiasm. Meanwhile,
I reaffirmed desire to keep supporting her
aspirations.
